reviewType: Independent read-only source review plus two isolated all-memory VM state-machine probes. No reviewer real-file ledger test, OS ownership probe, MCP/ACC/native/helper/GUI execution, build or source edit.
scope: Root ledger factory, manifest registration, in-process authority/await state machine, strict DJS configuration, immutable receipt/result flag binding, recovery holds and retirement watermarks. Ordinary dispatch is not activated.

findings.original: Node code.slice(0,100) used UTF16 code units, unlike Python code[:100] Unicode points; distinct valid astral-boundary receipt/result codes could collapse and be accepted as matching.
findings.correction: Node projection uses Array.from(code).slice(0,100).join, preserving the same 100-codepoint projection as Python.
findings.verification: Current source and three astral-boundary subcases inspected: 50 or 99 rockets followed by different X/Y remains unknown; exactly 100 rockets followed by omitted suffix matches only the intended bounded projection.

findings.original: A previous callback becoming false allowed a new factory to claim the directory while the old factory still awaited a store write. The old rename could erase a newly dispatching record even though its postcheck then reported owner_lost.
findings.correction: Canonical authority entries now carry queued/inflight activity count through all work, persistence and postchecks. A different authority cannot claim while previous.pending is nonzero; only drained plus no-longer-owned permits transfer.
findings.verification: Original isolated source VM reproduced newDispatchedEntryLost=true and new-session guard ok=true after releasing the old write. Current-source VM instead receives execution_owner_draining, then after old owner_lost preserves one unknown row and guard ok=false. Parent real-file regression also inspects drain-before-handover behavior.

findings.original: Deleting a verified delivered row on retirement also deleted duplicate identity protection; the same closed session/turn/call could be prepared again.
findings.correction: Persistent bounded closedTurns high watermarks include session, rewind generation and turn sequence; prepare/markDispatch reject closed or older generations/turns. Required isTurnCurrent callback and admissionId independently verify actual host scope before, inside and after async preparation/dispatch persistence.
findings.verification: Current source and reopen/retired-turn/new-turn/explicit-generation regressions inspected. A caller cannot establish a valid newer generation solely by changing a number; trusted live-host admission must approve it.

relatedStrengthening: Constructor now requires both root isOwner and synchronous live-host isTurnCurrent callbacks. Scope objects are copied/frozen and include sessionId, turnSeq, rewindGen and admissionId.

prepare snapshots client and argument data before async IO; admission is rechecked in the queue and after persistence before adding live status. markDispatch rechecks real client and host scope after recording the dispatch marker.

recordResult deliberately preserves late actual facts after the host turn stops, while new preparation/dispatch is refused. Ownership remains required; stopping a turn does not erase an executed result.
Retirement confirmation receives frozen rows plus explicit session/turn/generation scope, including for an empty turn; it no longer lacks target identity when rows is empty.
stateAndStorageAssessment: Strict cache:false, strictRead:true, quarantine:false, canonical/ordinary/bounded/private-owned DJS is used. The directory is private/owned/non-symlink with stable identity; state file reads are checked before/after the shared fd reader.

Canonical-directory authority prevents independent live write chains, now including pending transfer protection. This is an in-process policy and relies on the real external root/kernel ownership callback for cross-process exclusivity.

Prepared metadata is returned only after the ledger write/checks. In-epoch live preparations/dispatches are distinguished from missing live authority. Write/client/owner failures do not substitute a memory-only returned outcome.
Reopen converts undelivered prepared, dispatching and returned rows into persistent unknown holds. Delivered verified returned rows may remain terminal. Unknown stays held and cannot be retired.

Results and receipts are copied before awaits. Sidecar stores digests and bounded typed flags, not raw argument/result payloads. Ordinary numeric business exit codes are ignored as receipt code flags, consistent with Python.

Receipt inspection binds the actual invocation, ACC worker/PID, host session/turn/call/tool, raw preparation digest and decoded-value digest; top wrapper terminal flags must match the received result projection. Explicit unknown or incomplete lifecycle is held.

Receipt graph/private-blob validation still comes from the actual ACC product reader; this factory does not independently re-read Python private blobs. Synthetic claimed summaries in unit fixtures are not runtime provenance.

Entry capacity256 and closed-session-watermark capacity4096 refuse instead of pruning unknown state. Retirement requires verified delivered records plus explicit trusted closed-history/ACC-retention confirmation.

existingParentDevelopmentEvidence.scope: Isolated real private files, simulated ownership/admission callbacks and synthetic receipts. These unit logs are not actual OS-root/provider/ACC/native/CLI/subagent or process-restart runtime acceptance.

reviewerPureProbes.storage: All-memory stub filesystem/store; executed actual source slices in isolated VM.
reviewerPureProbes.evidenceTreatment: Summaries from original chat tool outputs; no standalone original-stdout or old source snapshot artifact was captured/reconstructed.

outcome: All three actionable findings identified in this factory review are closed in current v7 source. No remaining actionable source finding identified within this standalone factory scope.
mandatoryRemaining: Implement and independently qualify real kernel/server ownership and live session/turn/rewind/driver admission callbacks. A supplied function returning true in a fixture is not proof of ownership.

Only bind actual validated ACC reader responses and probe identities from the same captured real client; enforce required backend receipt coverage. This unit factory does not prove actual native entry or terminal by itself.
Wire exact immutable preparation plus dispatch marker at the actual direct/proxy/subagent/CLI bridge boundary, and recheck ownership/admission/client immediately before transmission.
Wire durable provider-history save and actual delivery digest before markDelivered; this factory stores a caller-supplied digest and does not yet prove a real history commit.
Implement trusted closed-turn history/ACC-retention confirmation and source-bound restart/runtime reconciliation. Unknown records must never be auto-replayed or retired.

New store remains the reviewed atomic-replacement primitive, without a newly claimed power-loss/fsync transaction guarantee. Whole persistence semantics and failure windows need end-to-end acceptance.
One-shot backend coverage, global retention behavior, ordinary owned action/fault-window acceptance and independent held-state rescue gates remain separate and open.
automaticLockRestoration: Only after whole P5 acceptance; no locking settings inspected or changed.
